slug: 2024-08-14 DRC's first Tier-III data centre goes live (OADC Texaf Digital, Kinshasa)

facts.fact: CIO Africa reports the open-access, carrier-neutral OADC Texaf Digital data centre, a joint venture of Open Access Data Centres (WIOCC) and TEXAF, went live in Kinshasa (2MW-capable).
CIO Africa states OADC Texaf Digital in Kinshasa is Uptime Institute Tier-III certified.
CIO Africa states two Tier-III data centres launched in Kinshasa in August 2024: OADC Texaf Digital and Raxio DRC1.

systems.owner: Open Access Data Centres (WIOCC) and TEXAF joint venture
